import torch
from b200probe import harness_time
torch.manual_seed(0)
D=3072
def ref(emb, w, b):
    out = torch.matmul(emb, w.t()) + b
    return out.chunk(6, dim=1)
print(torch.__version__, torch.backends.cuda.matmul.fp32_precision if hasattr(torch.backends.cuda.matmul,'fp32_precision') else 'no fp32_precision attr')
for B in (5, 32, 128, 919):
    emb = torch.randn(B, D, device='cuda'); w = torch.randn(6*D, D, device='cuda')/ (3*D)**0.5; b = torch.randn(6*D, device='cuda')
    with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA]) as p:
        ref(emb, w, b); torch.cuda.synchronize()
    print(B, [(e.key[:90], round(e.device_time,1)) for e in p.key_averages() if e.device_time>0])
    o = torch.empty(B, 6*D, device='cuda')
    outs = [torch.empty(B, D, device='cuda') for _ in range(6)]
    def full(emb, w, b, o): torch.matmul(emb, w.t(), out=o)
    def chunk6(emb, w, b, *outs):
        for i in range(6): torch.matmul(emb, w[i*D:(i+1)*D].t(), out=outs[i])
    def chunk6_addmm(emb, w, b, *outs):
        for i in range(6): torch.addmm(b[i*D:(i+1)*D], emb, w[i*D:(i+1)*D].t(), out=outs[i])
    t_full = harness_time(full, [emb,w,b],[o]); t_c6 = harness_time(chunk6,[emb,w,b],outs); t_c6a = harness_time(chunk6_addmm,[emb,w,b],outs)
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = True
    t_tf = harness_time(full, [emb,w,b],[o])
    with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA]) as p:
        full(emb,w,b,o); torch.cuda.synchronize()
    tfn = [(e.key[:90], round(e.device_time,1)) for e in p.key_averages() if e.device_time>0]
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
    fl = 2*B*6*D*D
    print(f"B={B}: full fp32 {t_full:.1f} us ({fl/t_full/1e6:.1f} TF/s); chunk6 {t_c6:.1f}; chunk6 addmm {t_c6a:.1f}; tf32 full {t_tf:.1f} us ({fl/t_tf/1e6:.1f} TF/s) {tfn}")

import ctypes, re, torch
from b200probe import harness_time
hdr = ''.join(open(p).read() for p in ['/usr/local/cuda/include/cublasLt.h','/usr/local/cuda/include/cublas_api.h','/usr/local/cuda/include/library_types.h'])
def enum(name):
    m = re.search(r'\b'+name+r'\s*=\s*(\d+)', hdr); return int(m.group(1))
E = {n: enum(n) for n in ['CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_TRANSA','CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_TRANSB','CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_EPILOGUE','CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_BIAS_POINTER','CUBLASLT_EPILOGUE_BIAS','CUBLASLT_MATMUL_PREF_MAX_WORKSPACE_BYTES','CUDA_R_32F','CUBLAS_OP_T','CUBLAS_OP_N']}
print(E)
lib = ctypes.CDLL('libcublasLt.so')
vp = ctypes.c_void_p
lib.cublasLtMatmulDescCreate.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(vp), ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int]
lib.cublasLtMatmulDescSetAttribute.argtypes=[vp, ctypes.c_int, vp, ctypes.c_size_t]
lib.cublasLtMatrixLayoutCreate.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(vp), ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_uint64, ctypes.c_uint64, ctypes.c_int64]
lib.cublasLtMatmulPreferenceCreate.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(vp)]
lib.cublasLtMatmulPreferenceSetAttribute.argtypes=[vp, ctypes.c_int, vp, ctypes.c_size_t]
lib.cublasLtMatmulAlgoGetHeuristic.argtypes=[vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,ctypes.c_int,vp,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int)]
lib.cublasLtMatmul.argtypes=[vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,ctypes.c_size_t,vp]
h = vp(); print('create', lib.cublasLtCreate(ctypes.byref(h)))
D=3072; N=6*D
ws = torch.empty(64<<20, dtype=torch.uint8, device='cuda')
def make(B, ctype):
    desc=vp(); st=lib.cublasLtMatmulDescCreate(ctypes.byref(desc), ctype, E['CUDA_R_32F'])
    ta=ctypes.c_int(E['CUBLAS_OP_T']); tb=ctypes.c_int(E['CUBLAS_OP_N']); epi=ctypes.c_int(E['CUBLASLT_EPILOGUE_BIAS'])
    lib.cublasLtMatmulDescSetAttribute(desc, E['CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_TRANSA'], ctypes.byref(ta), 4)
    lib.cublasLtMatmulDescSetAttribute(desc, E['CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_TRANSB'], ctypes.byref(tb), 4)
    lib.cublasLtMatmulDescSetAttribute(desc, E['CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_EPILOGUE'], ctypes.byref(epi), 4)
    la=vp(); lb=vp(); lc=vp()
    lib.cublasLtMatrixLayoutCreate(ctypes.byref(la), E['CUDA_R_32F'], D, N, D)
    lib.cublasLtMatrixLayoutCreate(ctypes.byref(lb), E['CUDA_R_32F'], D, B, D)
    lib.cublasLtMatrixLayoutCreate(ctypes.byref(lc), E['CUDA_R_32F'], N, B, N)
    pref=vp(); lib.cublasLtMatmulPreferenceCreate(ctypes.byref(pref))
    wsz=ctypes.c_size_t(ws.numel()); lib.cublasLtMatmulPreferenceSetAttribute(pref, E['CUBLASLT_MATMUL_PREF_MAX_WORKSPACE_BYTES'], ctypes.byref(wsz), 8)
    res=(ctypes.c_uint8*256)(); nret=ctypes.c_int(0)
    st=lib.cublasLtMatmulAlgoGetHeuristic(h, desc, la, lb, lc, lc, pref, 1, res, ctypes.byref(nret))
    return desc, la, lb, lc, res, st, nret.value
alpha=ctypes.c_float(1.0); beta=ctypes.c_float(0.0)
def run_lt(plan, emb, w, b, out):
    desc, la, lb, lc, res, _, _ = plan
    bp = vp(b.data_ptr()); lib.cublasLtMatmulDescSetAttribute(desc, E['CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_BIAS_POINTER'], ctypes.byref(bp), 8)
    st = lib.cublasLtMatmul(h, desc, ctypes.byref(alpha), vp(w.data_ptr()), la, vp(emb.data_ptr()), lb, ctypes.byref(beta), vp(out.data_ptr()), lc, vp(out.data_ptr()), lc, res, vp(ws.data_ptr()), ws.numel(), vp(torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream))
    return st
torch.manual_seed(0)
for B in (5, 32, 128, 384, 919):
    emb = torch.randn(B, D, device='cuda'); w = torch.randn(N, D, device='cuda')/(D)**0.5; b = torch.randn(N, device='cuda')
    ref64 = (emb.double() @ w.double().t() + b.double())
    line = f"B={B}:"
    for ctype, nm in ((68,'32F'),(78,'BF16X9'),(77,'TF32')):
        plan = make(B, ctype)
        if plan[6] == 0: line += f" {nm}: no algo (st {plan[5]});"; continue
        out = torch.empty(B, N, device='cuda')
        st = run_lt(plan, emb, w, b, out); torch.cuda.synchronize()
        err = (out.double()-ref64).abs().max().item()
        t = harness_time(lambda e,w_,b_,o: run_lt(plan,e,w_,b_,o), [emb,w,b],[out])
        with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA]) as p:
            run_lt(plan, emb, w, b, out); torch.cuda.synchronize()
        names = [(e.key[:60], round(e.device_time,1)) for e in p.key_averages() if e.device_time>0]
        fl=2*B*N*D
        line += f" {nm}: st{st} {t:.1f}us ({fl/t/1e6:.0f} TF/s) maxerr {err:.2e} {names};"
    print(line)

import ctypes, re, torch
from b200probe import harness_time, cuda_kernel
hdr = ''.join(open(p).read() for p in ['/usr/local/cuda/include/cublasLt.h','/usr/local/cuda/include/cublas_api.h','/usr/local/cuda/include/library_types.h'])
def enum(name): return int(re.search(r'\b'+name+r'\s*=\s*(\d+)', hdr).group(1))
E = {n: enum(n) for n in ['CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_TRANSA','CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_TRANSB','CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_EPILOGUE','CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_BIAS_POINTER','CUBLASLT_EPILOGUE_BIAS','CUBLASLT_EPILOGUE_DEFAULT','CUBLASLT_MATMUL_PREF_MAX_WORKSPACE_BYTES','CUDA_R_32F','CUBLAS_OP_T','CUBLAS_OP_N']}
lib = ctypes.CDLL('libcublasLt.so'); vp = ctypes.c_void_p
lib.cublasLtMatmulDescCreate.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(vp), ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int]
lib.cublasLtMatmulDescSetAttribute.argtypes=[vp, ctypes.c_int, vp, ctypes.c_size_t]
lib.cublasLtMatrixLayoutCreate.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(vp), ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_uint64, ctypes.c_uint64, ctypes.c_int64]
lib.cublasLtMatmulPreferenceCreate.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(vp)]
lib.cublasLtMatmulPreferenceSetAttribute.argtypes=[vp, ctypes.c_int, vp, ctypes.c_size_t]
lib.cublasLtMatmulAlgoGetHeuristic.argtypes=[vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,ctypes.c_int,vp,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int)]
lib.cublasLtMatmul.argtypes=[vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,vp,ctypes.c_size_t,vp]
h = vp(); lib.cublasLtCreate(ctypes.byref(h))
D=3072; N=6*D
ws = torch.empty(64<<20, dtype=torch.uint8, device='cuda')
def make(B, ctype, with_bias):
    desc=vp(); lib.cublasLtMatmulDescCreate(ctypes.byref(desc), ctype, E['CUDA_R_32F'])
    ta=ctypes.c_int(E['CUBLAS_OP_T']); tb=ctypes.c_int(E['CUBLAS_OP_N']); epi=ctypes.c_int(E['CUBLASLT_EPILOGUE_BIAS'] if with_bias else E['CUBLASLT_EPILOGUE_DEFAULT'])
    lib.cublasLtMatmulDescSetAttribute(desc, E['CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_TRANSA'], ctypes.byref(ta), 4)
    lib.cublasLtMatmulDescSetAttribute(desc, E['CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_TRANSB'], ctypes.byref(tb), 4)
    lib.cublasLtMatmulDescSetAttribute(desc, E['CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_EPILOGUE'], ctypes.byref(epi), 4)
    la=vp(); lb=vp(); lc=vp()
    lib.cublasLtMatrixLayoutCreate(ctypes.byref(la), 0, D, N, D); lib.cublasLtMatrixLayoutCreate(ctypes.byref(lb), 0, D, B, D); lib.cublasLtMatrixLayoutCreate(ctypes.byref(lc), 0, N, B, N)
    pref=vp(); lib.cublasLtMatmulPreferenceCreate(ctypes.byref(pref))
    wsz=ctypes.c_size_t(ws.numel()); lib.cublasLtMatmulPreferenceSetAttribute(pref, E['CUBLASLT_MATMUL_PREF_MAX_WORKSPACE_BYTES'], ctypes.byref(wsz), 8)
    res=(ctypes.c_uint8*256)(); nret=ctypes.c_int(0)
    lib.cublasLtMatmulAlgoGetHeuristic(h, desc, la, lb, lc, lc, pref, 1, res, ctypes.byref(nret))
    return desc, la, lb, lc, res
one=ctypes.c_float(1.0); zero=ctypes.c_float(0.0)
def mm(plan, A, Bm, out, beta, bias=None):
    desc, la, lb, lc, res = plan
    if bias is not None:
        bp = vp(bias.data_ptr()); lib.cublasLtMatmulDescSetAttribute(desc, E['CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_BIAS_POINTER'], ctypes.byref(bp), 8)
    return lib.cublasLtMatmul(h, desc, ctypes.byref(one), vp(A.data_ptr()), la, vp(Bm.data_ptr()), lb, ctypes.byref(beta), vp(out.data_ptr()), lc, vp(out.data_ptr()), lc, res, vp(ws.data_ptr()), ws.numel(), vp(torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream))
src = r'''
extern "C" __global__ void split_tf32(const float4* __restrict__ src, float4* __restrict__ hi, float4* __restrict__ lo, long n4) {
  long i = blockIdx.x * (long)blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; if (i >= n4) return;
  float4 v = __ldcs(src + i); float4 h, l; unsigned u;
  asm("cvt.rna.tf32.f32 %0, %1;" : "=r"(u) : "f"(v.x)); h.x = __uint_as_float(u); l.x = v.x - h.x;
  asm("cvt.rna.tf32.f32 %0, %1;" : "=r"(u) : "f"(v.y)); h.y = __uint_as_float(u); l.y = v.y - h.y;
  asm("cvt.rna.tf32.f32 %0, %1;" : "=r"(u) : "f"(v.z)); h.z = __uint_as_float(u); l.z = v.z - h.z;
  asm("cvt.rna.tf32.f32 %0, %1;" : "=r"(u) : "f"(v.w)); h.w = __uint_as_float(u); l.w = v.w - h.w;
  hi[i] = h; lo[i] = l;
}'''
split = cuda_kernel(src, 'split_tf32')
def do_split(x, hi, lo):
    n4 = x.numel()//4; split(((n4+255)//256,1,1),(256,1,1), x, hi, lo, n4)
torch.manual_seed(0)
for B in (5, 128, 384, 919):
    emb = torch.randn(B, D, device='cuda'); w = torch.randn(N, D, device='cuda')/(D)**0.5; b = torch.randn(N, device='cuda')
    ref64 = emb.double() @ w.double().t() + b.double()
    whi, wlo = torch.empty_like(w), torch.empty_like(w); ehi, elo = torch.empty_like(emb), torch.empty_like(emb)
    out = torch.empty(B, N, device='cuda')
    pb = make(B, 77, True); pn = make(B, 77, False); p32 = make(B, 68, True)
    def tf3(emb, w, b, out):
        do_split(w, whi, wlo); do_split(emb, ehi, elo)
        mm(pb, whi, ehi, out, zero, b); mm(pn, whi, elo, out, one); mm(pn, wlo, ehi, out, one)
    def tf3_nosplit(emb, w, b, out):
        mm(pb, whi, ehi, out, zero, b); mm(pn, whi, elo, out, one); mm(pn, wlo, ehi, out, one)
    def splitonly(emb, w, b, out): do_split(w, whi, wlo); do_split(emb, ehi, elo)
    tf3(emb, w, b, out); torch.cuda.synchronize()
    err = (out.double()-ref64).abs().max().item()
